_description: LiteLLM gateway request log → AKSI control ID mapping. LiteLLM is the most-used LLM gateway and ships callback logs that normalize 100+ providers behind an OpenAI-compatible shape. Each entry is one upstream call (completion/embedding/moderation/image). call_type drives the primary control; status=failure escalates to DE-01 FAIL; cost > threshold and guardrail_violation are additive signals.
